qc.label_under_test: Fires on the word piece 'ored' where it is its own token (lab+ored, flo+ored, ad+ored, sn+ored, mo+ored); quiet on -ored words that are single tokens (ignored, anchored, colored).

neighbours.label: Fires on a few split-off word pieces: 'ored' (lab+ored, arm+ored), 'nut' (chest+nut) and 'ark' (disemb+ark), when each is its own token; quiet on whole-token words like ignored, tailored, peanut, bookmark.
fire: The old horse labored up the steep hill with the cart behind it.
An armored truck pulled up outside the bank at exactly nine o'clock.
We roasted chestnuts over the fire on a cold December evening.
Passengers were asked to disembark through the rear doors of the plane.
Her breathing was labored after she climbed the twelve flights of stairs.
The knight's armored glove clanked against the stone wall.
A tall chestnut tree shades the corner of the village green.
After six days at sea, the crew finally began to disembark at the harbor.
quiet: The old horse walked slowly up the steep hill with the cart behind it.
A delivery truck pulled up outside the bank at exactly nine o'clock.
We roasted peanuts over the fire on a cold December evening.
Passengers were asked to leave through the rear doors of the plane.
Her warnings were ignored after she climbed the twelve flights of stairs.
The knight's tailored glove fit neatly against his hand.
A tall walnut tree shades the corner of the village green.
After six days at sea, the crew finally reached the landmark at the harbor.

predictions: Expect labored/disembark/chestnut to fire strongly; lowercase armored may be a single token and miss, so about 6/8 fire, 0 near misses.
